explanation: bootState and applyRoute are replaced by the pure route-landing module: boot seeds the page with applyPage over landHash, and Back/Forward lands through the same landHash/settleExplorer path. A refused boot link no longer saves its chart scale, a trackless or unknown-track URL lands on the default track, a Compare link with a bad analysis in any query position is refused, an unknown dataset pasted mid-session restores the address bar, and App renders the error page ahead of the expression survey.
